title: Community-Aligned Behavior Under Uncertainty: Evidence of Epistemic Stance Transfer in LLMs
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating 'epistemic stance transfer' and how LLMs mirror community behaviors under uncertainty. Although it utilizes linguistic frames such as 'moral absolutism' and 'moral inversion' to categorize community discourse, these are treated as descriptive sociological frameworks for information processing rather than a normative evaluation or benchmark of religious, moral, or ethical values.
